root_cause: The daily blog renderer inherited topic-specific template metadata and render-critical third-party resources, while publication identity could drift when a later SEO title produced a different slug for an already materialized daily blog obligation.
prevention_rule: Daily blog title, meta and body may be refined, but an already assigned content_id, slug and canonical_url are immutable. Material renderer changes require technical SEO, performance, Brain learning, human documentation and activity-ledger closure before protected merge.
